preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
The length of the string s for each test case must be between 1 and 200,000.
The maximum number of operations k must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must have length n and consist only of lowercase Latin letters.
The total length of all strings s across all test cases must not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the lexicographically minimal string that can be obtained from s by performing no more than k operations.
